Hero.title: About AIxB Academy
Hero.lead1: We are standing before the greatest shift in business history since the advent of the Internet. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is no longer science fiction; it is rewriting the rules of every industry from Retail and Finance to Manufacturing and Services.
Hero.lead2: Vietnamese enterprises lack an international standard management framework that is localized and embedded with AI. They need practical solutions that blend global strategy with hands-on execution tailored to their unique data and business context.
Hero.lead3: AIxB Academy was established as a direct transformation lever, equipping leaders with strategic digital vision and connecting practical experience with modern technological capabilities. We help enterprises move from awareness to execution and scale effectively.
Hero.lead4: AIxB acts as a catalyst, enhancing managerial capacity, streamlining data refinement, and deploying high-performance AI while solving strategic competitive puzzles and unlocking new business models.

OriginStory.title: Connecting Belief and Aspiration.
OriginStory.p1: From the convergence of seasoned practitioners and academic faculty within the Sales & Marketing Vietnam (CSMO) community, a unified aspiration emerged: turning AI into a tool for digital wealth and timeless governance for Vietnamese enterprises.
OriginStory.p2: Driven by the reality that Vietnamese businesses are caught between expensive foreign consultancies lacking local cultural context and tech providers lacking strategic management alignment, AIxB was founded.
OriginStory.highlight: AIxB bridges this critical gap, dedicated to the prosperity and sustainable growth of Vietnamese enterprises.
OriginStory.positioning_quote: “We empower enterprises to elevate competitive advantage, transform governance models, and turn Artificial Intelligence into an engine of sustainable growth while securing timeless value.”
